name: FA_LEASE_BOOKS_INT
description: This table contains book level information of lease.

columns.name: LEASE_BOOKS_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Lease book interface identifier.

columns.name: LEASE_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the lease interface row.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Name of the asset book in which lease is recorded.

columns.name: LEASE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of lease. Leases can be classified as capital or operating leases.

columns.name: GENERATE_INVOICE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether lease payment invoice is generated at asset level or lease level.

columns.name: PRESENT_VALUE
columns.description: Present value of future lease payment calculated using lessee's incremental borrowing rate.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Sum of the costs of all assets added from the lease.

columns.name: LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Present value of all amounts payable by the lessee to lessor over the lease term.

columns.name: LEASE_VAR_EXPENSE_ACCT_CCID
columns.description: Variable lease expense account code combination identifier.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NAME
columns.description: Transaction name for the asset. Free text field. No validations.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Classification of the lease transaction. Possible values are CREATE, UPDATE, and DELETE.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: WORKER_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for parallel processing.

columns.name: ERROR_MSG
columns.description: Error message detailing failure of the posting program.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning: process ID of the process that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: POSTING_STATUS
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Status of the lease schedule.

columns.name: LEASE_NUMBER
columns.description: User-defined lease number of the lease.

columns.name: NON_CANCELLABLE_LIFE_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Number of months lease contract cannot be cancelled.

columns.name: EXTEND_PERIOD_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Number of months the lease can be extended by the lessee.

columns.name: TERMINAL_PERIOD_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Number of months the lessee has an option to terminate the lease.

columns.name: EXERCISE_PURCHASE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether lessee wants to purchase the leased asset.

columns.name: EXERCISE_EXTEND_RENEW_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the lessee wants to renew the lease.

columns.name: EXERCISE_TERMINATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the lessee wants to terminate the lease.

columns.name: INITIAL_PRESENT_VALUE
columns.description: Present value of future lease payment calculated using lessee's incremental borrowing rate.

columns.name: FAIR_VALUE
columns.description: Fair market value of the lease asset.

columns.name: ECONOMIC_LIFE_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Period over which an asset is expected to be used in the business.

columns.name: REMAIN_ECONOMIC_LIFE_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Number of month remaining in the economic life of the leased asset.

columns.name: LESSOR_OPTION_PERIOD_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Number of months that the lessor can add to the term of the lease.

columns.name: AMORT_SCHEDULE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of amortization schedule for the lease and book.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Unique user-defined name for a batch of records in the interface table.

columns.name: GAIN_LOSS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Sum of the gain or loss amounts of all assets in the lease.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Unique lease identification number.

columns.name: LEASE_SCHEDULE_ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset level payment schedule is updated by the user.

columns.name: LEASE_TERM
columns.description: Stipulated length of the lease contract.

columns.name: LEASE_TO_REMAINING_LIFE_RATIO
columns.description: Ratio of the lease term to the remaining economic life.

columns.name: LEASE_TRANSACTION_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: General class of lease transaction.

columns.name: LEASE_TRANSACTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the transaction performed on the lease.

columns.name: LEASE_TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of transaction performed on the lease.

columns.name: MAJOR_LEASE_TERM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the lease term is for the significant part of economic life .

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_TRANSFERRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the ownership is transferred from lessor to lesse.

columns.name: SPECIALIZED_ASSET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the leased asset is a specialized asset.

columns.name: LEASE_ASSIGNMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the book assignment is performed on an existing lease.

columns.name: NEW_COST
columns.description: Sum of the new costs of all assets in the lease.

columns.name: NEW_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Sum of the new liability value of all assets in the lease.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_ASSETS
columns.description: Number assets added to the asset book from the asset lease.

columns.name: PV_TO_FV_SUBSTANTIAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the present value is substantially all of fair value.

columns.name: PV_TO_LEASE_FAIR_VALUE_RATIO
columns.description: Ratio of present value to fair value.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE

columns.name: CALC_MONTHLY_INTEREST_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether to calculate monthly accrued interest for the lease with quarterly, semi-annually or annual frequency.
